newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Land-locked Ethiopia auctions off 16 warships.
newsitem.headline: Land-locked Ethiopia auctions off 16 warships.

text.p: The Ethiopian Defence Ministry said on Tuesday 16 warships of its former navy anchored at the Red Sea port of Djibouti were auctioned on Monday.
Ethiopia became land-locked, losing its 600-km (370-mile) Red Sea coastline along with the naval base at the port of Massawa, when its northern province of Eritrea became independent in 1993.

The ships -- which included a Swedish-made attack vessel and many Soviet-made missile carriers -- had remained idle at the port in neighbouring Djibouti since the overthrow of dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam in 1991.
The ministry did not say how much the ships fetched at the auction or who bought them.
